statement: Static (XL, no-mutant) solving degree of a unit prime chain instance equals delta + maxwt(supp g^-1): proof SD1 (ml-cryptanalysis docs/proofs), re-derived and brute-force validated 344/344 by an independent validator at m=2 k<=5 and m=3 k=2; measured sd^stat = 2k+2 (m=2, k=3..13) and 3k+6 (m=3, k=2..8); binary proper m=2 systems d_full in {k+1,k+2} for k=2..8; validator report attested, unsigned.
